hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'git push'; then echo 'pmkit: `git push` needs an explicit yes from the human. Show the branch and target, then ask.' >&2; exit 2; fi
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'git merge'; then echo 'pmkit: merging needs an explicit yes from the human.' >&2; exit 2; fi
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'gh pr create'; then echo 'pmkit: opening a pull request needs an explicit yes from the human.' >&2; exit 2; fi
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'gh pr merge'; then echo 'pmkit: merging a pull request needs an explicit yes from the human.' >&2; exit 2; fi
